studysheet.title: Modern Algebra Exam 2
studysheet.description: Subgroups, cosets, normal subgroups, and homomorphisms.

cards.definition:
If $G$ is a finite group and $H \le G$, then $|H|$ divides $|G|$. More precisely,
$$|G| = [G : H]\,|H|.$$
The converse fails: $A_4$ has order 12 but no subgroup of order 6.
A subgroup $N \trianglelefteq G$ with $gNg^{-1} = N$ for all $g \in G$.
If $\varphi : G \to H$ is a homomorphism, then $$G/\ker\varphi \cong \operatorname{im}\varphi.$$
A group generated by a single element: $G = \langle g \rangle$. Every subgroup of a cyclic group is cyclic.
$\ker\varphi = \{ g \in G : \varphi(g) = e_H \}$. It is always a normal subgroup of $G$.
